oldblock=re.search(pattern,before).group(0);newblock=re.search(pattern,after).group(0)

def declarations(s):
 out={}
 for name,kind,value in re.findall(r'(?m)^([a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+)(==| @ )([^\n]+)',s):
  normalized=re.sub(r'[-_.]+','-',name).lower();out[normalized]=value.rstrip(' \\')
 return out
old=declarations(before);new=declarations(after)
added=sorted(set(new)-set(old));removed=sorted(set(old)-set(new))
changed=[{'name':n,'before':old[n],'after':new[n]} for n in old.keys() & new.keys() if old[n]!=new[n]]
assert len(old)==len(new)==176
assert not added and not removed
assert changed==[{'name':'urllib3','before':'2.7.0','after':'2.8.0'}]
expected=json.loads((p/'urllib3-artifacts.json').read_text())
hashes=re.findall(r'--hash=sha256:([a-f0-9]+)',newblock)
assert sorted(hashes)==sorted(a['sha256'] for a in expected)

print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
